mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 6 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate lower borrowing costs and increased liquidity.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 6 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate profit growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as economic slowdown expectations rise.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue expectations fall.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate output growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances during late-cycle expansion when INDPRO declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 305.0 signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as discount rates rise and corporate margins compress.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 305.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 6 months indicates robust manufacturing growth that supports corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO has risen over the prior 6 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1600.0 thousand units signals housing market contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as economic activity expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances where HOUST falls below 1600.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicate labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and spending, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE rises and PAYEMS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.
